message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. The top features the large red word "TEMPO," above which is yellow text reading "LAPORAN KHUSUS HARI KEBANGKITAN TEKNOLOGI NASIONAL." Centered in white is "KISRUH TENTARA MASUK SAWAH." Below this, a block of gray Indonesian text is visible.

The central image depicts two human figures in an open landscape. On the right, a large, stout man wearing a tan short-sleeved collared shirt and goggles on his head stands inside the turret of a small, dark-colored tank. He points his left hand forward. The tank sits on a dirt surface. Behind the tank on the left, a slender man wearing a conical straw hat, a light-colored long-sleeved shirt, and dark trousers stands on a parched field. He holds a long, flexible, segmented tube that connects to the rear of the tank, suggesting a physical interaction between the two.

The background shows a hazy landscape with silhouetted trees and smoke rising into a pale orange and gray sky. A red border frames the left and bottom edges. The bottom left contains a barcode and various publication details including "10-16 AGUSTUS 2020" and "RP 45.000," while a QR code is on the bottom right.
